lead_summary.zh: 克宮：川習普19日會；伊朗再襲巴林
lead_summary.en: Kremlin: Trump-Xi-Putin to meet Nov 19; Iran hits Bahrain again

title.zh: 克宮：川習普19日深圳會面　首度三方峰會
title.en: Kremlin says Trump, Xi and Putin will meet in Shenzhen on Nov 19

body.zh: 克宮發言人佩斯科夫 14 日向塔斯社表示，三方已同意於 11 月 19 日在深圳亞太經合會（APEC）峰會場邊會面，這將是三國元首首次三方會晤；白宮發言人 12 日也曾表示領袖將在 APEC 期間會面。川普曾表示希望藉此討論美伊戰爭，以及納入三國的核武協議構想，一名匿名美國官員則說川普將提出伊朗議題但不談烏克蘭，並形容這只是核裁軍對話的開端，預料不會宣布協議。美俄《新削減戰略武器條約》已於 2 月到期；烏克蘭總統澤倫斯基表示，若討論烏克蘭的未來，烏方必須參與。
body.en: Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told TASS on the 14th that the three sides had agreed to meet on November 19 in Shenzhen on the sidelines of the APEC summit, which would be the first-ever three-way meeting of the leaders; a White House spokeswoman had said on the 12th that they would meet during APEC. Trump has said he wants to discuss the US war with Iran and his idea of a three-way nuclear arms deal, while an anonymous US official said he would raise Iran but avoid Ukraine, describing the meeting as the start of a conversation on nuclear disarmament with no agreements expected. The US-Russia New START treaty expired in February; Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has said Ukraine must be involved if its future is discussed.

title.zh: 伊朗再派無人機襲巴林　巴方稱已攔截
title.en: Iran launches second drone attack on Bahrain; Manama says drones intercepted

body.zh: 巴林 15 日清晨約 4 時與 6 時半傳出爆炸聲並響起警報，當局發布 9 月以來首次避難警示，巴林軍方與外交部表示防空系統已攔截伊朗無人機，並譴責伊朗、拒絕讓領土成為「算帳的場域」。伊朗革命衛隊稱以 6 架無人機攻擊巴林里法直升機基地的美軍防空雷達，宣稱荷莫茲海峽「已關閉」，並警告美方若再攻擊將遭更強烈回應；革命衛隊另稱 14 日在格什姆島上空擊落一架美軍 MQ-1 無人機，美方未證實。這是三天內第二波攻擊，美軍中央司令部表示 13 日曾擊落兩架飛向巴林的無人機，無人傷亡或損害。
body.en: Explosions were heard in Bahrain at around 4am and 6:30am on the 15th as sirens sounded and authorities issued their first shelter alert since September; Bahrain's military and foreign ministry said air defences intercepted the Iranian drones, held Iran responsible and rejected the use of its territory as an arena for settling scores. Iran's Revolutionary Guards said six drones targeted a US air-defence radar at the Riffa helicopter base, declared the Strait of Hormuz closed and warned of a harsher response to any further US attack; the Guards also said they shot down a US MQ-1 drone over Qeshm Island on the 14th, which the US has not confirmed. It was the second such attack in three days; US Central Command said it downed two drones headed for Bahrain on the 13th, with no casualties or damage.

title.zh: 美航管全國停飛逾4小時　萬餘航班取消
title.en: US nationwide ground stop leaves over 14,000 flights cancelled

body.zh: 美國聯邦航空總署（FAA）13 日因航管雷達與通訊不穩，下令全國機場暫停起飛約 4 小時 20 分，為 911 事件後第二次全國性停飛；據 ABC 報導，13、14 兩日共有逾 1.4 萬架次航班取消，15 日下午仍有約 2,300 架次取消。FAA 署長貝德福德稱原因是設備故障、「零證據」顯示有人蓄意破壞，預期週末結束前恢復正常；運輸部長達菲表示，阿肯色州與德州各有一套系統在維修或更換後向網路大量傳送資料，已關閉 69 台路由器的廣播功能，聯邦調查局也參與調查，路由器供應商 HPE 則稱設備運作正常。民主黨議員要求說明原因，紐約州長要求達菲下台，川普則歸咎拜登政府讓老舊系統惡化。
body.en: The Federal Aviation Administration halted departures nationwide for about four hours and 20 minutes on the 13th after radar and communications instability, only the second nationwide ground stop since 9/11; ABC reported more than 14,000 flights cancelled on the 13th and 14th, with about 2,300 more cancelled as of Sunday afternoon. FAA Administrator Bryan Bedford blamed faulty equipment, saying there was zero evidence of anything nefarious, and expected recovery by the end of the weekend; Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy said systems in Arkansas and Texas flooded the network after maintenance or replacement and that 69 routers had their broadcast function switched off, with the FBI involved, while router maker HPE said its equipment worked properly. Democratic lawmakers demanded answers and New York's governor called for Duffy to resign, while Trump blamed the Biden administration for worsening an old system.

title.zh: 以軍空襲加薩醫院　18國聯合譴責
title.en: 18 Arab and Islamic nations condemn Israeli strike on Gaza hospital

body.zh: 以色列空襲加薩南部汗尤尼斯的納瑟醫療中心，哈瑪斯主管的加薩衛生部稱至少 6 人死亡、逾 20 人受傷，包括兒童與醫護人員。埃及、卡達、沙烏地阿拉伯、土耳其、印尼、巴基斯坦等 18 個阿拉伯與伊斯蘭國家外長 14 日發表聯合聲明，指攻擊違反國際人道法，要求以色列全面遵守停火並解除人道物資進入加薩的限制。以軍與辛貝特則表示，空襲目標是哈瑪斯汗尤尼斯旅指揮官，尚未確認其是否身亡，以軍並稱已放行更多帳篷進入加薩、累計達 9.3 萬頂。
body.en: An Israeli airstrike hit the Nasser Medical Complex in Khan Younis in southern Gaza; the Hamas-run Gaza health ministry said at least six people were killed and more than 20 wounded, including children and medical staff. Foreign ministers of 18 Arab and Islamic countries, including Egypt, Qatar, Saudi Arabia, Turkey, Indonesia and Pakistan, said in a joint statement on the 14th that the attack violated international humanitarian law and urged Israel to fully uphold the ceasefire and lift restrictions on aid entering Gaza. The Israeli military and Shin Bet said the strike targeted Hamas's Khan Younis Brigade commander and had not confirmed whether he survived; the military also said it had allowed more tents into Gaza, bringing the total to 93,000.

title.zh: 星艦上節首度被塔臂接住　邁向完全重複使用
title.en: SpaceX catches Starship's upper stage with tower arms for first time

body.zh: SpaceX 星艦第 15 次試飛於美國時間 13 日晚間自德州星艦基地升空，約 22.5 小時後，上節 Ship 42 自軌道返回，於 14 日美東時間下午 4 時 20 分被發射塔機械臂接住，是首次成功回收上節。原計畫上下兩節都由塔臂接回，但超重型助推器因燃料偏低警示改在墨西哥灣濺落；此次任務也在低軌道部署 26 顆 Starlink V3 衛星。SpaceX 表示，接回上節是邁向火箭完全重複使用的關鍵一步，可加快檢修與再次飛行。
body.en: SpaceX's 15th Starship test flight lifted off from Starbase in Texas on the evening of the 13th US time, and about 22.5 hours later the Ship 42 upper stage returned from orbit and was caught by the launch tower's arms at 4:20pm EST on the 14th, the first time an upper stage has been recovered this way. A planned double catch did not happen because the Super Heavy booster was diverted to a splashdown in the Gulf of Mexico after a low-fuel alarm; the mission also deployed 26 Starlink V3 satellites into low Earth orbit. SpaceX said catching the upper stage is a key step toward full rocket reuse, allowing faster inspection and reflight.

title.zh: 輝達17日財報　黃仁勳卸任後首度登場
title.en: Nvidia reports Nov 17, its first results since Huang's exit

body.zh: 輝達將於美國時間 17 日公布財報，這是黃仁勳 11 日辭去執行長後首份財報，由財務長兼代理執行長克瑞斯主持說明會。公司先前預估本季營收約 1,080 億美元（上下 2%），據 Motley Fool 整理，分析師預期約 1,090 億美元、調整後每股盈餘 2.47 美元，毛利率預估由 75% 降至約 74%；輝達股價 13 日收 162.85 美元，較 10 月高點跌逾三成。中央社引述投顧指出，財報與財測將牽動全球股市；野村投信則點名新執行長人選、CUDA 生態系、產品藍圖與客戶信心為觀察重點。
body.en: Nvidia will report results on November 17 US time, its first since Jensen Huang resigned as CEO on the 11th, with CFO and interim CEO Colette Kress leading the call. The company had guided for revenue of about US$108 billion, plus or minus 2%; according to the Motley Fool, analysts expect about US$109 billion and adjusted EPS of US$2.47, with gross margin guided down to about 74% from 75%, and the shares closed at US$162.85 on the 13th, more than 30% below their October peak. CNA cited an investment adviser saying the results and guidance will drive global markets, while Nomura Asset Management Taiwan listed the new CEO choice, the CUDA ecosystem, the product roadmap and customer confidence as key points to watch.

title.zh: 上市櫃第3季賺1.96兆　年增逾七成
title.en: Taiwan-listed firms earn NT$1.96 trillion in Q3, up 74.5%

body.zh: 據 FTNN 新聞網 14 日報導，截至當日已有 1,859 家上市櫃公司公布第三季財報，合計稅後淨利新台幣 1.96 兆元，較去年同期成長 74.51%，其中 116 家單季每股盈餘創歷史新高。目前逾九成上市櫃公司已公布財報，其餘預計於 16 日前完成申報。
body.en: FTNN News reported on the 14th that 1,859 listed and OTC companies had released third-quarter results, with combined net profit of NT$1.96 trillion, up 74.51% from a year earlier, and 116 of them posting record quarterly earnings per share. More than 90% of listed and OTC companies have now reported, with the rest due by the 16th.

title.zh: 半導體產值今年估9.76兆　年增近五成
title.en: Taiwan chip output seen at NT$9.76 trillion this year, up ~50%

body.zh: 工研院產科國際所透過台灣半導體產業協會公布，第三季台灣半導體產值達新台幣 2.662 兆元、年增 59.4%，其中記憶體年增 340.1% 表現最強，晶圓代工年增 49.6%。該所預估第四季產值 2.9421 兆元、年增 66.7%，全年產值可達 9.7615 兆元、成長 49.7%；晶圓代工主要由台積電帶動，記憶體則受嚴重缺貨與價格大漲推升。
body.en: ITRI's industry research arm, via the Taiwan Semiconductor Industry Association, said Taiwan's semiconductor output reached NT$2.662 trillion in the third quarter, up 59.4% year on year, led by memory, which jumped 340.1%, while foundry rose 49.6%. It forecast fourth-quarter output of NT$2.9421 trillion, up 66.7%, and full-year output of NT$9.7615 trillion, up 49.7%, with foundry growth led mainly by TSMC and memory lifted by severe shortages and sharp price increases.

title.zh: 中國外匯存準率升至6%　15日生效
title.en: China lifts FX deposit reserve ratio to 6% from Nov 15

body.zh: 中國人民銀行 11 月 3 日宣布，將金融機構外匯存款準備金率由 4% 上調至 6%，自 11 月 15 日起生效，為近五年來首度上調。人民幣今年前 9 個月對美元累計升值 4.2%，10 月再升約 0.8% 至 6.65 附近；民生銀行首席經濟學家溫彬表示，此舉可收緊境內美元流動性，緩和人民幣升值壓力並穩定市場預期。
body.en: The People's Bank of China announced on November 3 that it would raise financial institutions' foreign-currency deposit reserve ratio from 4% to 6%, effective November 15, its first increase in nearly five years. The yuan gained 4.2% against the dollar in the first nine months of the year and about 0.8% more in October to around 6.65; China Minsheng Bank chief economist Wen Bin said the move tightens onshore dollar liquidity, easing appreciation pressure and steadying expectations.

title.zh: 義大利罰Meta 8.05億歐元　涉擅取相簿
title.en: Italy fines Meta €805 million over Facebook photo access

body.zh: 義大利個資保護機構 Garante 14 日宣布對 Meta 處以 8.05 億歐元罰款，為該機構史上最高。Garante 認定臉書 Android 應用程式的相簿建議功能預設開啟、同意說明過於籠統，在未取得明確同意下存取用戶相片、影片與後設資料，估計約 2,000 萬名義大利用戶可能受影響，並下令 Meta 修正。罰款約占 Meta 全球營收 0.47%；報導刊出時 Meta 尚未公開回應，可提出上訴。
body.en: Italy's data protection authority, the Garante, said on the 14th it had fined Meta €805 million, its largest penalty ever. It found that a gallery-suggestions feature in Facebook's Android app was on by default with an overly generic consent notice, accessing users' photos, videos and metadata without specific consent, potentially affecting about 20 million Italian users, and ordered Meta to fix it. The fine equals about 0.47% of Meta's global turnover; Meta had not commented publicly at the time of reporting and can appeal.

headline.zh: 台股週漲3,973點　單週漲幅10.01%
headline.en: TAIEX gains 3,973 points, up 10.01% on the week

body.zh: 加權指數 13 日終場上漲 583.25 點、收 43,675.12 點，漲幅 1.35%，盤中最高 44,489.48 點、最低 43,534.12 點，成交值 9,162.55 億元；櫃買指數收 342.41 點、漲 6.68 點（1.99%）。本週（11/9–11/13）加權指數由 39,701.64 點升至 43,675.12 點，累計上漲 3,973.48 點、漲幅 10.01%，鉅亨網引述富蘭克林證券投顧指出為本週亞洲表現最強市場，主要動能之一是台積電 10 月營收約 5,868.9 億元、年增 59.7%，創單月新高。13 日台積電漲 10 元、收 2,350 元，聯發科漲 270 元至 4,120 元；三大法人合計買超 439.65 億元，其中外資買超 288.36 億元，結束連續 11 個交易日賣超。
body.en: The TAIEX closed up 583.25 points, or 1.35%, at 43,675.12 on the 13th, after trading between 44,489.48 and 43,534.12, with turnover of NT$916.26 billion; the TPEx index closed at 342.41, up 6.68 points or 1.99%. For the week of November 9-13 the TAIEX rose from 39,701.64 to 43,675.12, a gain of 3,973.48 points or 10.01%, which Anue, citing Franklin Securities Investment Consulting, said made it Asia's best-performing market, helped by TSMC's record October revenue of about NT$586.89 billion, up 59.7% from a year earlier. On the 13th TSMC rose NT$10 to NT$2,350 and MediaTek gained NT$270 to NT$4,120; the three major institutional groups bought a net NT$43.965 billion, including NT$28.836 billion from foreign investors, ending an 11-session foreign selling streak.

flows_note.zh: 外資（含陸資）買超 288.36 億元，終止連續 11 個交易日賣超；三大法人同步買超。
flows_note.en: Foreign (incl. mainland) investors bought a net NT$28.836 billion, ending an 11-session selling streak; all three groups were net buyers.

headline.zh: 美股：費半挫3.43%　三大指數週線收高
headline.en: US close, Nov 13: SOX sinks 3.43%; major indexes up for week

body.zh: 週五（13 日）美股晶片股遭賣壓，道瓊小漲 0.10%、收 52,347.55 點，為唯一收紅的主要指數，標普 500 跌 0.40%、收 7,561.67 點，那指跌 0.91%、收 25,136.27 點，費城半導體指數重挫 3.43%；台積電 ADR 跌 1.69%、收 398.63 美元。輝達收跌約 2%，週線累計下跌 12.75%，市場聚焦黃仁勳去職後的接班與下週二財報，前一日大漲的超微重挫 8.75%。10 年期美債殖利率約 5.15%，加上 Anthropic 即將上市，促使投資人重新評估 AI 類股評價；以週線計，標普 500 仍上漲約 2.51%、那指漲 2.27%、道瓊漲 2.07%。
body.en: On Friday, November 13, chip stocks came under selling pressure: the Dow edged up 0.10% to 52,347.55, the only major index to finish higher, while the S&P 500 fell 0.40% to 7,561.67, the Nasdaq 0.91% to 25,136.27 and the SOX 3.43%; the TSMC ADR lost 1.69% to US$398.63. Nvidia closed down about 2% for a weekly loss of 12.75% as investors focused on succession after Jensen Huang's exit and its results due Tuesday, and AMD, which had rallied the day before, sank 8.75%. A 10-year Treasury yield near 5.15% and Anthropic's upcoming listing led investors to reassess AI valuations; for the week, the S&P 500 still gained about 2.51%, the Nasdaq 2.27% and the Dow 2.07%.
